data.name: Zouhri: The Cursed Blood
data.detailed_description:
📌 About This Demo

Step into the nightmare. Your blood is your only guide.

This official demo of Zouhri: The Cursed Blood plunges you into the opening chapter of a brutal descent into the darkness of Moroccan folklore. What begins as a desperate search for your missing sister near an isolated shrine turns into a fight for survival against forces once thought to be mere legends.

📜 The Story So Far

Your younger sister has vanished. The authorities are helpless, but you know this is no ordinary disappearance. You are both "Zouhris"—children born with "cursed" blood, coveted by sorcerers and spirits for ancient, blood-stained rituals.

Guided by a GPS signal and your supernatural intuition, your investigation leads you to Sidi Mimoun, a hidden village frozen in time. Here, the walls whisper, the shadows watch, and the ancient myths of the Jinn are terrifyingly real.

🔥 Demo Key Features:

  • The Cursed Village: Explore the eerie, fog-covered ruins of Sidi Mimoun. Navigate narrow alleyways and discover a world where the boundary between our reality and the spiritual realm has shattered.

  • The Horror of the Hammam: Face your first major trial in a traditional Moroccan Hammam haunted by the vengeful spirit of Lalla Malika. Use your wits to survive the suffocating steam and solve environmental puzzles to escape her deadly grasp.

  • Ritualistic Combat & Stealth: You are not a soldier; you are prey. Survive against possessed Aissawa mobs and spectral entities. Choose your path: hide in the shadows, flee for your life, or fight back using ritualistic items and the guidance of the mysterious Sidi Ali.

Will you survive this first ritual and find the path to your sister, or will the spirits of the curse claim you?

data.short_description: Dive into the horrors of Moroccan folklore. You are a "Zouhri," a child with cursed blood coveted by sorcerers and Jnoun. Explore forgotten shrines and survive terrifying rituals to save your kidnapped sister before she becomes a sacrifice.
